prompt: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.
sentence: He passed away in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July.
options: in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July
at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950
on 13 July at 10 a.m. in the year 1950
in the year 1950 on 13 July at 10 a.m.
explanation: English orders time expressions from the smallest to the largest unit: time, then date, then year.
